
```{r}
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap) # map making
library(kableExtra) # table formatting
library(spData) # spatial data
library(spDataLarge) # spatial data
library(geodata) # spatial data
```


```{r}
# Read in the data
wc <- st_read('data/wc_regions_clean.shp')
sst_2008 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
sst_2009 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
sst_2010 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
sst_2011 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
sst_2012 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')
```

```{r}
# Compare SpatRaster geometries
compareGeom(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012, ext = TRUE, res = TRUE, crs = TRUE)

# Stack the rasters
sst <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)
plot(sst) # Check stack worked
```


```{r}
# Double check all dataframe's CRS match
if((st_crs(wc) == st_crs(sst)) & (st_crs(sst) == st_crs(depth))){
  print("It's a match")
} else {
  warning("Coordinate refrence systems do not match") # Include a warning if the dataframes don't have matching CRS
}
```


```{r}
# Mean SST from 2008-2012
mean_sst <- app(sst, fun = mean)

# Convert average SST from Kelvin to Celsius
mean_sst_c <- mean_sst - 273.15
```


```{r}
# Crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
depth_crop <- crop(depth, mean_sst_c)

# Check if it worked
cat("\n=== Resolution comparison ===\n")
cat("Original depth:", dim(depth), "\n")
cat("Depth cropped:", dim(depth_crop), "\n")
```


```{r}
# The resolutions of the SST and depth data do not match
res(depth)
res(mean_sst_c)

# Resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach
depth_resampled <- resample(depth, mean_sst_c, method = "bilinear")

# Double check that everything matches
cat("After resampling depth:\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(mean_sst_c) == res(depth_resampled)), "\n")
cat("Origins match:    ", all(round(origin(mean_sst_c), 8) == round(origin(depth_resampled), 8)), "\n")
cat("Extents match:    ", ext(mean_sst_c) == ext(depth_resampled), "\n")
cat("CRS match:        ", same.crs(mean_sst_c, depth_resampled), "\n")
```
